primary.title: Big dividends, thin profits? 7 stocks that are paying out more than they earn - CyberTech to UTI AMC
primary.summary: Several companies, including IL&FS Investment Managers, CyberTech Systems and Premco Global, paid dividends exceeding their FY26 net profits. Their payout ratios reached 1,000%, 245.6% and 242.8%, respectively, highlighting why high dividend yields alone may not tell investors the full story.
